item.title: author post
item.content:encoded:
This was inspired by EldritchCyanide's short writing challenge from October on the wiki's official blog, for which my entry was this. I decided a few weeks ago that I really wanted to explore that idea further, especially for a skip that is so highly rated but gets so little attention, so here we are.

Ideally I would have had this run by more people, but it sat in the draft forums for a rather long time and each time I came to 19 there weren't enough people around to review it, so I'm posting this now because my goal for this year is to post an article a month and today is the 31st.

AJMansfield both suggested having actual colored sections rather than horizontal lines/divided sections and wrote the CSS for it (visible in page source) so they get the biggest thank-you. Also thank you to WrongJohnSilver for the first reviews during the earliest draft stages, MrWrong, and Oboebandgeek99 (I think I remembered your name correctly) and anyone from chat I forgot.
